text.en: Standing on a mountain and looking up at the sky, I watch the white clouds wandering overhead. At moments the earth itself seems to move, while the houses rise and fall like sampans and ocean liners. Across oceans and great rivers, wherever we are able to sail, we may never travel over every part of Mother Earth. Even in passing, however, we may glimpse her skin and the places where her bones lie exposed—the mountains, ridges and valleys. The blue sky is the cover above us, changing through day and night, sun and moon, and the turning seasons.
text.zh-Hans: 站在山上向天空仰望，覺得天上的白雲在遊走，偶爾也會覺得地在走，房屋似此起彼伏的舢板與郵輪。在海洋、大河，在我們能夠航行的地方，我們雖未遊走在這大地母親的每一處，哪怕只是走馬觀花，也可以看看地母的每處肌膚、每處骨骼外露之處——那是山脈與丘壑。那藍天是我們的被蓋，晝日夜月，四季變換。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Standard lexical translation

rationale.en: Translation is kept as the lexical baseline. Language Book mapping begins with the independently evidenced semantic operations inside Latin universus and compares Chinese candidates without claiming cognacy.
rationale.zh-Hans: 翻译仅作为词义底座；Language Book Mapping 从拉丁语 universus 内部有独立证据的语义操作出发，再比较汉语候选，不主张同源。

summary.en: Latin universus is historically analyzed as unus + versus (the participial form of vertere): one + turned, hence all together or whole. Chinese character histories are evaluated separately.
summary.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 universus 的标准历史分析为 unus + versus（vertere 的分词形式）：一＋转成，继而表示共同整体；汉字词史另行评估。

claim.en: universus: unus + versus / verto, ‘turned into one; combined into one whole.’
claim.zh-Hans: universus：unus＋versus／verto，即“转成一个、合为整体”。

claim.en: 轉 is glossed as 運也 in Shuowen; later lexicographic material records motion and rotation senses.
claim.zh-Hans: 《说文》释“轉”为“運也”；后世字书记录移动、旋转义。

claim.en: 斡 has an independently attested turn/rotate sense: ‘斡，轉也.’
claim.zh-Hans: “斡”有独立可证的旋转义：“斡，轉也”。

claim.en: 渦 is attested as 回川 with the gloss 旋流, supporting eddy/whirlpool rather than a cross-language origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: “渦”见“回川”并注“旋流”，支持旋流／漩涡义，不支持跨语言同源。

claim.en: Huainanzi distinguishes 宙 as past-to-present time and 宇 as the four directions plus above and below.
claim.zh-Hans: 《淮南子》以“宙”指古往今来的时间，以“宇”指四方上下的空间。

summary.en: Modern Mandarin wò/wō forms are recorded as a testable sound–meaning cluster. Shared modern syllables do not establish common Chinese ancestry or relation to Latin VERS/VERT.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代普通话 wò／wō 形式作为可检验音义簇记录；现代音节相同既不证明汉字彼此同源，也不证明它们与拉丁 VERS／VERT 同源。

claim.en: Modern 斡 wò, 涡 wō, 窝 wō and 蜗 wō may be compared around TURN / CURVE / ROTATION, with separate lexical evidence for every character.
claim.zh-Hans: 现代“斡 wò、涡 wō、窝 wō、蜗 wō”可围绕 TURN／CURVE／ROTATION 比较，但每个字须各用独立词义证据。

summary.en: The comparison models two independently evidenced constructions—ONE + TURNED → WHOLE and SPACE + TIME → COSMOS—then marks ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE as a cognitive-geometric extension.
summary.zh-Hans: 比较并列两条独立有据的构词结构——ONE＋TURNED→WHOLE 与 SPACE＋TIME→COSMOS；ROTATION→VORTEX／CURL／ENCLOSURE 另标为认知—几何延伸。

claim.en: Abstract → Motion → Geometry → Symbol: TURN → ROTATION → VORTEX / CURL / ENCLOSURE.
claim.zh-Hans: 抽象→动作→几何→符号：TURN→ROTATION→VORTEX／CURL／ENCLOSURE。

summary.en: Cognitive Trace, the author’s spiral-motion proposal, and Cosmic Motion Encoding are explicitly speculative/testable. Etymology does not establish a scientific model of the universe.

claim.zh-Hans: 现代普通话：斡 wò、涡 wō、窝 wō、蜗 wō；相近的现代读音只用于提出聚类检验。

text.en: When the violin sounded, it was like a small stream flowing through the forest. As the violin's current rose, I was passing a majestic church. I saw its two round corner towers, its circular window, and tracery radiating like the sun. A saint extended his arms as though an angel were beckoning; behind him, a halo shone like another sun. Columns recalled an ancient Athenian temple. A gentleman in a top hat passed through the great doorway. The violin's rising and falling melody made me imagine a pair of immortal companions drifting down from the mountains of the Middle Ages. Was this music I had once known, or a composer's new work? Sunlight touched the church's marble wall and spread over it a pale layer of yellow. It was frozen music.

text.en: People of the civilized world, who have moved from place to place from ancient times until today—you are the bearers of civilization; civilization stands behind you. title.en: A Bridge Toward the Spacefaring Age
title.zh-Hans: 通向宇航时代的语言桥梁

text.zh-Hant: 架起語言之間的橋梁，讓我們面對未來的宇航時代。當你聽別人說出英語、法語的時候，由於有通語 Collanguage 所建立的規則與想像，你會自動把語句轉化成高低錯落、如音樂般的漢語，實現一種美好的交流。考慮文化因素，把漢語拼音用於跨語系的語言研究，這就是《語言書》Languagesbook 所探尋和追求的。它可以把兩件原本不相干的事情聯繫起來；在文學與想像中，這種聯繫不必先具備嚴格的歷史邏輯。我在我的葡萄園裡，瑪娜花盛開。
text.en: By building bridges between languages, we prepare ourselves for the spacefaring age ahead. When you hear someone speaking English or French, the rules and imagination developed through Collanguage may let you transform the utterance into Chinese, rising and falling like music, and thus create a beautiful exchange. To bring Chinese pinyin into cross-language-family research while attending to culture: this is what Languagesbook seeks. It may connect two things that at first seem unrelated; in literature and imagination, such a connection need not begin with strict historical logic. In my vineyard, the Mana flowers are in bloom.

evidence_boundary.en: The bridge, musical transformation and vineyard are the author's literary and methodological vision. They do not establish phonetic correspondence, cognacy or the historical segmentation a + bash.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 语言桥梁、音乐式转化与葡萄园属于作者的文学及方法论愿景；它们不能证明规律语音对应、同源关系或 a＋bash 的历史切分。

gloss.en: A monastery or convent governed by an abbot or abbess; also its buildings or church
gloss.zh-Hans: 由男修道院院长或女修道院院长主持的修道院，也可指其建筑或教堂

meaning.en: The primary Chinese lexical equivalent is 修道院. 比, 笔 and 蓓 are not standard translations.
meaning.zh-Hans: 主要汉语词义对应是“修道院”；“比”“笔”“蓓”都不是标准翻译。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Reviewed lexical equivalent

rationale.en: Authoritative English and French dictionaries define the word as a monastic institution. The Chinese target records that ordinary lexical meaning; sound and literary candidates remain separate observations.
rationale.zh-Hans: 权威英语、法语词典均把该词定义为修道制度中的机构。汉语目标记录普通词义对应；声音候选与文学候选另轨保存。

summary.en: English abbey came through Middle English and Anglo-French from Medieval Latin abbātia. The base title abbās/abbot ultimately reflects Aramaic abba ‘father’ through ecclesiastical Greek and Christian Latin. This supports an indirect historical connection to Abba, not a direct borrowing from a modern Jewish form and not a relation to Chinese bi/bei.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey 经中古英语和盎格鲁-法语进入，来源是中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。其基础称谓 abbās／abbot 又经教会希腊语和基督教拉丁语上溯至阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。这说明它与 Abba 有间接的深层词史联系，并非直接借自某个现代犹太教形式，也不证明与汉语 bi／bei 有历史关系。

claim.en: Middle English abbeye/abbay was borrowed from Anglo-French abeie/abbaye, from Medieval Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abbeye／abbay 借自盎格鲁-法语 abeie／abbaye，后者来自中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。

claim.en: French abbé comes from Christian Latin abbās, transmitted through ecclesiastical Greek from Aramaic abba ‘father’; abbaye is derived from that abbatial title through Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbé 来自基督教拉丁语 abbās；该称谓经教会希腊语源自阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。abbaye 则经拉丁语 abbātia 从这一院长称谓派生。

claim.en: French abbesse is borrowed from Christian Latin abbatissa, a derivative of abbas, and names the female head of an abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbesse 借自基督教拉丁语 abbatissa，是 abbas 的派生词，指女修道院院长。

summary.en: Modern abbey /ˈæbi/ has a surface-final resemblance to Mandarin bǐ /pi/; French abbaye /a.be.i/ and abbé /a.be/ can also sound loosely similar to bi/bei. These are non-systematic modern-form resemblances. 比 and 笔 lack the required lexical meaning; 蓓 gains relevance only through a literary metaphor.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 的词尾与普通话 bǐ /pi/ 有表面近似；法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/ 与 bi／bei 也可能产生宽泛听感近似。这些都不是系统音变。“比”“笔”缺少所需词义，“蓓”只通过文学隐喻获得关联。

claim.en: abbey-final /bi/ and 比/笔 bǐ /pi/ share a high front vowel and a labial stop, but differ in voicing/phonological system, syllable position and Mandarin tone.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 词尾 /bi/ 与“比／笔”bǐ /pi/ 共享高前元音与唇塞音，但在浊音／音系、音节位置及普通话声调上不同。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/ and 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯/ offer a loose auditory resemblance, but no regular historical correspondence or independent lexical-semantic match has been shown.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/ 与“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯/ 有宽泛听感近似，但尚无规律历史对应或独立词义对应。

summary.en: The standard concept is a monastic institution/community. Spiritual cultivation as growth is a plausible interpretive frame, but the bud-to-rose transformation belongs to the literary layer.
summary.zh-Hans: 标准概念是修道机构／共同体。“灵魂修持如成长”可作解释性框架，但“蓓蕾长成玫瑰”的转换属于文学层。

summary.en: The 比, 笔 and 蓓 comparisons are retained as separately graded author observations. None is historical evidence or a replacement for 修道院.
summary.zh-Hans: “比”“笔”“蓓”的比较作为分别分级的作者观察保留；均不是历史证据，也不替代“修道院”。

claim.en: 比 bǐ is a phonetic candidate only; no supporting abbey-related lexical meaning is recorded.
claim.zh-Hans: “比”bǐ 仅为声音候选；未记录与修道院相关的支持性词义。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ is a weak/speculative observation. The proposed ‘using a pen’ interpretation lacks an independently established semantic bridge to abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 是弱／推测性观察。“用笔”的解释缺少独立成立的语义桥梁。

claim.en: 蓓 bèi / 蓓蕾 is a literary phonetic-semantic association: an abbey imagined as a place where the soul develops like a rosebud.
claim.zh-Hans: “蓓”bèi／“蓓蕾”是文学性的声音—语义联想：把修道院想象为灵魂如玫瑰蓓蕾般成长之所。

claim.en: English abbey /ˈæbi/ ends in /bi/, while Mandarin 比 and 笔 are bǐ /pi˨˩˦/.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 以 /bi/ 结尾；普通话“比”“笔”为 bǐ /pi˨˩˦/。

limitations.en: This is a surface resemblance, not a demonstrated sound law. English /b/ and Mandarin pinyin b represent different phonetic categories, and Mandarin tone has no counterpart here.
limitations.zh-Hans: 这是表面音似，不是已证明的音变规律。英语 /b/ 与普通话拼音 b 所代表的语音范畴不同，普通话声调在此也无对应。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/, abbé /a.be/ and abbesse /a.bɛs/ share the historical abb-/ab- family; 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ only resembles part of these modern sounds.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/、abbesse /a.bɛs/ 属于有词史关系的 abb-／ab- 词族；“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ 只与部分现代音形近似。

limitations.en: The relation among the French forms is historical; their resemblance to Chinese bei is not. Surface similarity must not be transferred across those two claims.
limitations.zh-Hans: 法语各形式之间有历史关系；它们与汉语 bei 的近似没有已证历史关系。不能把前一事实转移成后一结论。

semantic_structure.relation: RELIGIOUS INSTITUTION → MONASTIC COMMUNITY; literary extension: SPIRITUAL CULTIVATION → GROWTH

claim.en: The final syllable of abbey may invite a phonetic association with 比 bǐ, without a semantic or historical claim.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 的末音节可能引发与“比”bǐ 的声音联想，但不提出语义或历史关系主张。

counterexamples: No abbey-related lexical meaning in 比
English voicing vs Mandarin aspiration contrast
Unmatched tone and first syllable

testability.en: Use blinded similarity ratings with unrelated /bi, pi, bei/ controls; semantic support must be tested separately.
testability.zh-Hans: 可用盲法相似度评分，并加入无关 /bi、pi、bei/ 负对照；语义支持必须另行检验。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ may be heard as similar to abbey-final /bi/, but ‘using a pen’ does not currently supply a supported abbey meaning.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 在听感上可能接近 abbey 词尾 /bi/，但“用笔”目前不能提供有支持的修道院词义。

counterexamples: No independent semantic bridge
Many unrelated words can share /bi/-like syllables
Not a standard translation

testability.en: Require a preregistered semantic criterion and negative controls before promotion; otherwise retain as a weak observation.
testability.zh-Hans: 升级前须预先注册语义判据并设置负对照；否则只保留为弱观察。

claim.en: Abbaye/abbey and 蓓 bèi can support a literary image of an abbey as a place where the soul grows like a bud, without etymological force.
claim.zh-Hans: abbaye／abbey 与“蓓”bèi 可支持“修道院如灵魂蓓蕾成长之所”的文学意象，但不具有词源证明力。

counterexamples: No demonstrated historical correspondence
蓓蕾 is not the standard translation of abbey
Metaphorical meaning supplied by the author

testability.en: Evaluate as literary reception or mnemonic association, not as an etymological hypothesis.
testability.zh-Hans: 应作为文学接受或记忆联想评价，而不是词源假说。

proposition.en: An abbey is a place where the soul is cultivated like a bud opening toward a rose.
proposition.zh-Hans: 修道院如灵魂的蓓蕾之所，在修持中向玫瑰生长。

evidence_boundary.en: The bud, rose and spiritual-growth image is authored literature. It is searchable and preserved, but it is not lexical translation, historical etymology or independent semantic evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 蓓蕾、玫瑰与灵魂成长的意象属于作者文学创作。它可检索、被保留，但不是词义翻译、历史词源或独立语义证据。

boundary.en: 肚 dù is shown first as a concise Chinese body-part candidate. The standard translation remains 腹部 / 肚子, and no common historical origin is claimed.
boundary.zh-Hans: 先展示单字“肚”dù，作为简洁的汉语身体词候选；通用翻译仍是“腹部／肚子”，不主张共同历史来源。

gloss.en: The part of the body between the thorax and pelvis; belly
gloss.zh-Hans: 胸部与骨盆之间的身体部位；腹部、肚子

meaning.en: 腹部/腹 is the standard formal translation; 肚子 is the standard everyday equivalent and the selected Chinese mapping. The isolated form 肚 dù is additionally preserved as an experimental phonetic-semantic candidate.
meaning.zh-Hans: “腹部／腹”是标准正式译法，“肚子”是标准日常对应词，也是本条选定的主要汉语 Mapping；单字“肚”dù 另作为实验性语音—语义候选保留。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Reviewed lexical equivalent with separate phonetic-semantic candidate

rationale.en: The ordinary lexical equivalence is strong in the BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY field. The sound comparison is independently low-confidence and does not imply common origin.
rationale.zh-Hans: 普通词义对应在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场中明确成立；声音比较另列为低置信候选，不暗示共同来源。

summary.en: English and French abdomen are learned borrowings from Latin abdōmen, with the oblique stem abdōmin-. The deeper origin of the Latin word is uncertain. Therefore ab.dom.en is not accepted as a historical segmentation. English abdominal and French abdominal/abdominale are derivatives of abdomen, not evidence for a dom root shared with dome or domain.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语和法语 abdomen 都是源自拉丁语 abdōmen 的学术借词，其斜格词干为 abdōmin-。该拉丁词更深层来源仍不确定，因此不把 ab.dom.en 接受为历史构词切分。英语 abdominal 与法语 abdominal／abdominale 是 abdomen 的派生词，不能据此推出它们与 dome 或 domain 共享 dom 词根。

claim.en: English abdomen was borrowed from Middle French and Latin; Latin abdōmen meant the belly or paunch and is of uncertain origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen 借自中古法语与拉丁语；拉丁语 abdōmen 指腹部或大肚子，其来源不确定。

claim.en: French abdomen is a learned sixteenth-century borrowing from Latin abdomen; French abdominal is derived from French abdomen with the adjectival suffix -al.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是十六世纪从拉丁语 abdomen 借入的学术词；法语 abdominal 由法语 abdomen 加形容词后缀 -al 派生。

claim.en: A derivation from Latin abdere ‘hide, conceal’ has been proposed, but major dictionary treatment regards it as doubtful; no deeper decomposition is asserted here.
claim.zh-Hans: 有人提出它可能与拉丁语 abdere“隐藏”有关，但主要词典认为这一解释可疑；本记录不主张任何更深层构词切分。

claim.en: Domain, domestic, dominant and dominate belong to a house/master family through Latin domus, dominus, dominium and dominari. Architectural dome follows a Greek/late-Latin/Romance building-roof path. These histories do not derive from abdomen or from a belly sense.
claim.zh-Hans: domain、domestic、dominant、dominate 经拉丁语 domus、dominus、dominium、dominari 属于“家屋／主人”词族。建筑义 dome 则走希腊语—晚期拉丁语—罗曼语的建筑／屋顶路径。这些词史都不源自 abdomen，也不源自“肚子”义。

summary.en: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ and 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ meet clearly in BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY meaning. Sound support is only partial: the second syllable begins with English /d/, while Mandarin pinyin d represents an unaspirated voiceless coronal stop [t]; abdomen also contains /b m n/ with no counterpart in 肚, and 肚 has lexical tone.
summary.zh-Hans: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 与“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 词义上明确相交。声音支持仅属局部：abdomen 第二音节以英语 /d/ 起首，而普通话拼音 d 表示不送气清冠音 [t]；abdomen 另有 /b m n/，在“肚”中无对应，并且“肚”带词汇声调。

claim.en: The proposed domen/dom ↔ 肚 comparison reduces to a partial coronal-stop resemblance plus a strong semantic intersection; it is not the same consonant skeleton.
claim.zh-Hans: 所提 domen／dom ↔“肚”的比较可归结为局部冠音塞音近似加明确语义交点；二者并不是相同的辅音骨架。

summary.en: The authorial chain ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL is a coherent imaginative model, not a historical derivation. The Chinese hand/control imagery is preserved as a cross-cultural cognitive note without expanding it into an origin claim.
summary.zh-Hans: 作者提出的 ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 是连贯的想象模型，不是历史派生链。汉语“手—支配”意象作为跨文化认知札记保留，不扩展成词源主张。

claim.en: A convex belly can be imagined through the shape of a dome and as a bodily container or personal domain.
claim.zh-Hans: 凸起的肚子可借圆顶形状来想象，也可被想象为身体容器或个人领域。

claim.en: Chinese expressions such as 手下 and the image 翻手为云，覆手为雨 associate hand imagery with subordination or control; this note is cultural-semantic, not etymological.
claim.zh-Hans: “手下”以及“翻手为云，覆手为雨”的意象把“手”与从属或支配相联；此处只作文化语义札记，不作词源解释。

summary.en: The proposed abdomen → dome → domain/control chain is retained as an authored association but rejected as a historical derivation. Similar spelling does not merge distinct etymological families.
summary.zh-Hans: 所提 abdomen → dome → domain／control 链作为作者联想保留，但作为历史派生关系不成立。拼写相似不能合并不同词源族。

claim.en: Segmenting abdomen as ab.dom.en and treating dom as the productive root is unsupported by the attested Latin form and its uncertain deeper origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 把 abdomen 切分为 ab.dom.en 并把 dom 当作能产词根，得不到已见拉丁语形式及其不确定深层来源的支持。

claim.en: Dome ‘rounded roof’, belly roundness, domain and control may form a literary-cognitive association, but the chain is not the historical source of the words.
claim.zh-Hans: dome“圆顶”、肚子的圆凸、domain 与 control 可构成文学—认知联想，但不是这些词的历史来源链。

claim.en: English abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ contains /d/ at the onset of its second syllable; Mandarin 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ begins with the pinyin d sound, phonetically an unaspirated [t].
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 的第二音节以 /d/ 起首；普通话“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 以拼音 d 所记的不送气 [t] 起首。

limitations.en: The stops share coronal place but differ in voicing and phonological system. /b m n/ and Mandarin tone are unmatched, so d-m or d-m-n cannot be claimed as a shared consonantal skeleton.
limitations.zh-Hans: 两者塞音同属冠音部位，但清浊及音系不同；/b m n/ 与普通话声调均无对应，因此不能宣称共享 d-m 或 d-m-n 辅音骨架。

proposition.en: Is the belly our domain?
proposition.zh-Hans: 肚子是我们的领地吗？

text.en: Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the little dudou covering our bellies look like? We seem to have forgotten. In memory, a child's face is fresh and luminous, while the body still grows to nature's oldest rhythms. Girls, when nature gave you faces as gentle and radiant as moonlight, it also let life move with the waxing and waning moon. Boys, when nature gave you faces bright as sunlight, it also let life rise and fall with the sun. The abdomen may be imagined as an inner territory of the body, holding hunger, breath, growth, and our earliest memories.

gloss.en: A proper name for the 7,782-metre mountain in Nyingchi, Tibet Autonomous Region, at the eastern end of the Himalayas.

meaning.en: Named-entity correspondence, not an ordinary lexical translation. Tibetan གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ། (gnam lcags ’bar ba) can be read lexically as ‘blazing sky-iron / meteorite’ or, with gnam lcags understood as lightning, ‘blazing lightning.’ The Chinese 南迦巴瓦 is a sound-based transcription, not a semantic translation.
meaning.zh-Hans: 这是专名形式对应，不是普通词汇翻译。藏文 གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།（gnam lcags ’bar ba）按词面可理解为“燃烧／闪耀的天铁（陨铁）”，若把 gnam lcags 取“雷电／霹雳”义，则可理解为“燃烧／闪耀的雷电”。汉语“南迦巴瓦”属于音译，不是意译。

rationale.en: The Romanized and Chinese forms identify the same place. Name-meaning reports are kept as separate, attributed evidence items and are not converted into a phonetic-semantic candidate.

orthography_note.en: Tibet Daily's Tibetan-language site, the Rangjung Yeshe place entry and Kyoto University's academic Tibet map use gnam without a final s. Some secondary web sources print གནམས / gnams; this entry adopts the better-attested གནམ / gnam form and records the variant without treating it as primary.

assessment.en: 南迦巴瓦 approximately follows the sound sequence Nam-jag-bar-wa; 峰 adds the Chinese geographic classifier ‘peak.’ The individual Chinese character meanings are not a translation of the Tibetan morphemes.
assessment.zh-Hans: “南迦巴瓦”大体按 Nam-jag-bar-wa 的音节转写，“峰”补出汉语地理类别。南、迦、巴、瓦各字的汉语字义不用于翻译藏文词素。

analysis.en: Closest among the published Chinese explanations when gnam lcags is read as lightning and ’bar ba as blazing/burning. ‘如火’ is explanatory rather than a separate Tibetan morpheme.
analysis.zh-Hans: 在公开汉语解释中最接近藏文结构：gnam lcags 可取“雷电”，’bar ba 可取“燃烧／闪耀”。其中“如火”是汉语说明性补充，并非另有一个对应藏文词素。

analysis.en: A direct compositional rendering of gnam ‘sky’ + lcags ‘iron/metal’ + ’bar ba ‘blaze/burn/shine.’ Princeton's Dictionary of Buddhism similarly gives ‘Blazing Meteor.’
analysis.zh-Hans: 按 gnam“天”＋lcags“铁／金属”＋’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”组合出的较直接译法。《普林斯顿佛教辞典》亦将整词释作“Blazing Meteor（燃烧的流星／陨星）”。

translation_assessments.chinese: 直刺蓝天的战矛／直刺天空的长矛

analysis.en: The Tibetan written form contains no separately identifiable morpheme for spear, battle or piercing. This is best labelled an image associated with the mountain's shape and the Gesar epic tradition, not a literal translation.
analysis.zh-Hans: 藏文词面中没有可分别对应“长矛／战矛”“刺入”的词素。较合理的身份是结合山形与《格萨尔王传》传统形成的形象化文化解释，而非直译。

analysis.en: It reflects the ‘sky-iron / meteorite’ sense of gnam lcags, but changes iron/metal to stone and omits ’bar ba ‘blazing.’
analysis.zh-Hans: 它抓住了 gnam lcags“天铁／陨铁”的来源意象，但把“铁／金属”泛化为“石头”，并省略了 ’bar ba“燃烧／闪耀”。

analysis.en: An attested honorific epithet. The written name contains no morpheme meaning mountain, many/all, or father, so it is not a translation of the name.
analysis.zh-Hans: 这是有资料记录的尊称。藏文名称中没有“山”“众”“父”对应词素，因此不是山名字面翻译。

summary.en: Authoritative and institutional sources agree on the place identity and commonly report 7,782 metres, but published explanations of the Tibetan name vary and do not establish one exclusive etymology here.
summary.zh-Hans: 权威及机构来源对地点身份一致，并普遍采用海拔 7782 米；但公开资料对藏语名称的解释不一，本词条不据此确立唯一词源。

claim.en: Tibetan-language and academic geographic sources record the name as གནམ་ལྕགས་འབར་བ།, Wylie gnam lcags ’bar ba.

claim.en: Dictionary evidence supports gnam ‘sky,’ gnam lcags ‘meteoric iron / thunderbolt / lightning,’ and ’bar ba ‘blaze, burn, shine,’ making ‘blazing sky-iron / meteor’ or ‘blazing lightning’ the closest lexical analyses.

claim.en: A Tibet Autonomous Region government page reports the name as meaning ‘a battle spear piercing the blue sky.’
claim.zh-Hans: 西藏自治区人民政府页面将名称释为“直刺蓝天的战矛”。

claim.en: China Tibet Online reports multiple explanations: ‘lightning burning like fire’ and ‘a long spear piercing the sky’; it connects the latter image with the ‘Battle of Menling’ in the Epic of King Gesar.

claim.en: The Nyingchi municipal government identifies Namcha Barwa as a 7,782-metre mountain at the eastern end of the Himalayas and the highest mountain in Nyingchi.

text.zh-Hans:
看过南迦巴瓦山的一些照片，很喜欢西藏这个藏在漫漫群山中的秀丽山峰。

南迦巴瓦山啊，
你是我的心里的少男少女，
是我自己心里的透出熏香味的向往，
还是我自己那少年时代的持续？
那美丽是就像我看到那青春的照片，
那是少年时代的情绪的青涩，
那不正是你的青春似的树🌳与湖吗？
有愿望的我想保持一颗爱你的心💕，
因为我的爱你的光芒，
将使你的青春的面容总是清秀。

你轻柔的云的面纱，
你貌似的对我发出尊重的话语，
可是我却总是希望撕下，
你的优雅的话语所包围的遮幕，
总是想看到你的真容，
在走进你心底的森林的深处，
我却晓得了你的柔美的如丽水般，
流淌的心如歌声的，
在与你温煦话语的对话，
与你激烈的对抗中，
我却对你产生了从我的心底，
流出的一种爱意。
text.en:
After seeing photographs of Namcha Barwa, I came to love this beautiful Tibetan peak hidden among range upon range of mountains.

O Namcha Barwa,
you are the young men and women within my heart,
the longing in me that breathes the fragrance of incense,
or perhaps the continuation of my own youth.
That beauty is like a photograph of youth before my eyes,
the tender greenness of a young heart—
are those not your youthful trees 🌳 and lake?
I long to keep a heart that loves you 💕,
for the radiance of my love for you
will keep your youthful countenance forever clear.

Your tender veil of cloud,
the reverent words you seem to speak to me—
and yet I am always longing to tear away
the curtain woven around you by your graceful speech,
always longing to behold your true face.
Deep in the forest where I enter your innermost heart,
I come to know your gentleness, lovely as clear water,
your flowing heart, like a song.
In our dialogue of warm words,
in our fierce confrontation,
there rises in me, from the bottom of my heart,
a current of love for you.
text.fr:
Après avoir vu quelques photographies du Namcha Barwa, j’ai aimé ce beau sommet du Tibet, caché au milieu de chaînes de montagnes sans fin.

Ô Namcha Barwa,
tu es les jeunes hommes et les jeunes femmes au fond de mon cœur,
le désir qui, en moi, exhale un parfum d’encens,
ou peut-être la continuité de ma propre jeunesse.
Ta beauté ressemble à une photographie de la jeunesse sous mes yeux,
à la tendre verdeur des émotions adolescentes —
ne sont-ce pas là tes arbres 🌳 et ton lac, pareils à la jeunesse ?
Je désire garder un cœur qui t’aime 💕,
car la lumière de mon amour pour toi
gardera toujours limpide ton visage de jeunesse.

Ton léger voile de nuages,
les paroles respectueuses que tu sembles m’adresser —
pourtant, je désire toujours déchirer
le rideau dont m’entourent tes paroles pleines de grâce,
je désire toujours contempler ton vrai visage.
Au plus profond de la forêt où j’entre dans le secret de ton cœur,
je découvre ta douceur, belle comme une eau claire,
ton cœur qui s’écoule comme un chant.
Dans le dialogue de tes paroles chaleureuses,
dans l’affrontement ardent avec toi,
naît pourtant en moi, du plus profond de mon cœur,
un courant d’amour pour toi.

source.raw_note:
在花园里，水仙，迎春，春兰，杜鹃花、牡丹，月季，她们同时在春天盛开。和风吹在我的花园内，吹動着花的香气。

詩歌
南迦巴瓦，愿你保留你的容颜
看过南迦巴瓦山的一些照片，很喜欢西藏这个藏在漫漫群山中的秀丽山峰。
南迦巴瓦山啊，
你是我的心里的少男少女，
是我自己心里的透出熏香味的向往，
还是我自己那少年时代的持续？
那美丽是就像我看到那青春的照片，
那是少年时代的情绪的青涩，
那不正是你的青春似的树🌳与湖吗？
有愿望的我想保持一颗爱你的心💕，
因为我的爱你的光芒，
将使你的情青的面容总是清秀。
你轻柔的云的面纱，
你貌似的对我发出尊重的话语，
可是我却总是希望撕下，
你的优雅的话语所包围的遮幕，
总是想看到你的真容，
在走进你心底的森林的深处，
我却晓得了你的柔美的如丽水般，
流淌的心如歌声的，
在与你温煦话语的对话，
与你激烈的对抗中，
我却对你产生了从我的心底，
流出的一种爱意。
